## Bontiful
This datapack are just some useful items that could've been 10000000x easier to put in a mod but I don't know java. (but i 

## Items:

<details>
<summary>Bottle of Allay</summary>
Obtained by bottling an Allay by [Sneak + Use item] a Glass Bottle onto it.
Renaming the Bottle also renames the resulting Allay
</details>


<details>
<summary>Calibrated Recovery Compass</summary>

  Obtained by "calibrating" a Recovery Compass using 3 Amethyst Shards and an Ender Pearl
Using the item will teleport you to your **LAST** death point. 
(using it when dying to the void or on hardcore/not died yet does nothing)

  **Can be only be used ONCE per life and reverted on use**
  
</details>

<details>
<summary>Copper Arm</summary>

Extends reach by +4 Blocks, has 190 durability and gets damaged for each block place above the default place range.

Can be repaired with Copper Ingots but cannot be enchanted*

</details>

<details>
<summary>Tome o' Knowledge</summary>

Can store up to 50 levels of experience for later use.

</details>


\* because it's a poisonous potato, and datapack limitations.
